relevance.rationale: Join CORRECT (arXiv:2505.00799v2, McSpirit-Rolen, 'Quantum Modular Forms and Resurgence', revised 29 May 2025, matching the registered entry). BIB ORPHAN: full-tree grep returns zero citation sites in content/; the only hit is docs/audits/2026-08-01-fantini-wheeler-summability-c3-borel-reframe.md:102, where it is discussed by name but never cited from a block. The paper unifies all of Zagier's original quantum-modular examples under resurgence, strengthens known quantum-modularity results for holomorphic Eichler integrals of half-integer-weight modular forms, and - its stated main addition - proves median-resummation results showing the holomorphic quantum modular forms considered can be recovered from their asymptotics. That last point is the one that bears on the folio: median resummation of a divergent asymptotic series is exactly the operation the c_k / Stokes-constant work needs, and the corpus already has a Borel-summability audit that names this paper. Supporting rather than core: nothing derives from it yet, and I have not checked whether the folio's series fall in the class its median-resummation theorems cover.

keyResults.locator: Sec. 1, 'main addition to the literature' (median resummation results)
keyResults.statement: The holomorphic quantum modular forms treated can be recovered from their asymptotic expansions (or those of closely related functions) by median resummation.
keyResults.useForFolio: A recovery-from-asymptotics statement is the resurgence-side counterpart of the Habiro/Stokes framing; it would give the c1/GGM bar-parity and Stokes-DT blocks a citable resummation result instead of an informal appeal to resurgence.
